sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Project Workbench is the primary workspace for Project Leads. It uses a master-detail layout: a project list on the left and a three-tab workspace on the right. You can also arrive here via deep links from Portfolio Overview.

sections.title: Project List
sections.body:
The left panel shows projects filtered by your role. Project Leads see their assigned projects; Controllers see all. Each entry shows the project name, RAG indicator, type badge, and next action due. Projects in Draft or Pending Approval status also appear for PLs with appropriate status badges.

Use the **New** button at the top to create a new project draft. The creation form collects project name, description, Line of Business, CapEx/OpEx classification, start/end months, and optional resource plan allocation.

sections.title: Overview Tab
sections.body: Shows project metadata (name, LoB, status, RAG, timeline), the 3-point comparison table (Baseline vs Current Forecast vs Actuals with variance columns), a monthly trajectory line chart (three lines showing baseline, forecast, and actuals over time), CapEx/OpEx breakdown, and resource plan summary.

sections.title: 3-Point Comparison
sections.body: The comparison table shows three rows (Baseline, Current Forecast, Actuals) broken out by internal hours, external costs, and total. Variance columns show Plan Drift (forecast vs baseline), Execution Variance (actuals vs forecast), and Total Variance (actuals vs baseline). This gives a complete picture of where the project stands.

sections.title: Forecast & Planning Tab
sections.body: In read mode, shows the current forecast grid with months as columns and resource roles + external cost types as rows. To edit, start a Monthly Review cycle which walks through 5 phases: Retrospective, System Suggestions, Editing, Review, and Submit.

sections.title: Monthly Forecast Wizard
sections.body: **Phase 1 (Retrospective):** Review last month's forecast vs actuals and acknowledge variances. **Phase 2 (Suggestions):** System shows AI-generated insights based on trends, burn rates, and utilization patterns. Apply or dismiss each suggestion. **Phase 3 (Editing):** Edit the forecast grid directly — both hours and external costs. **Phase 4 (Review):** See all changes grouped by category with old/new/delta values. Add justification text. **Phase 5 (Submit):** Changes become CRs routed to CC Owners for Stage 1 confirmation.

sections.title: Change History Tab
sections.body: Shows the chronological log of all change requests for this project. Each CR displays its status, category, summary, timestamp, and whether it was system-suggested. Click any CR to see full details including line-item changes, justification, CC Owner confirmation details, and Controller approval status.

sections.title: System Suggestions
sections.body: The system analyzes spending patterns and generates suggestions during the forecast wizard. Types include trend-based adjustments, burn rate projections, actuals-based corrections, and utilization insights. System-suggested changes are flagged in the resulting CR for controller transparency.

sections.title: Project Submission Workflow
sections.body:
New projects follow a multi-step submission lifecycle:

**1. Create Draft:** Project Lead clicks 'New' in the project list, fills in project details and an optional resource plan with monthly hour allocations. The project is saved as 'draft' status.

**2. Submit for Review:** PL clicks 'Submit' to send the draft for CC Owner confirmation. The forecast snapshot is saved as the 'original' submission. Status becomes 'pending_cc_confirmation'.

**3. CC Owner Confirmation:** The CC Owner reviews and confirms resource availability. Status moves to 'pending_approval'.

**4. Controller Review:** The controller reviews the submission in the Portfolio Overview Intake Queue. They can Approve (project becomes active), Reject (back to draft), or Request Changes (opens editable forecast grid to propose modifications).

**5. Changes Requested:** If the controller requests changes, the PL sees an amber banner in the Workbench with the controller's feedback. The PL can 'Review Proposed Changes' to see a diff view, then 'Accept Changes' or 'Edit and Resubmit'.

sections.title: Changes Requested Banner
sections.body:
When a controller requests changes to a submitted project, the Project Lead sees an amber notification banner at the top of the project workspace. The banner shows the controller's feedback text and provides two actions:

- **Review Proposed Changes** — opens a diff view comparing the PL's original submission against the controller's proposed changes, with changed cells highlighted
- **Edit and Resubmit** — opens the forecast grid for the PL to make their own adjustments before resubmitting

The same diff view is also accessible from the Intake Queue in Portfolio Overview by clicking 'Open Full Detail' on a project with 'changes_requested' status.
